title: Edit gradient stops independently for every palette

request.text: Mỗi palette đều được thay đổi màu stop ở bên trong, thay vì chỉ mỗi custom được thay đổi. Palette Fiora sẽ sử dụng setup màu của palette Custom hiện tại.

decision: Reuse one mutually exclusive native gradient editor for each named palette, persisted under separate canonical targets. Seed Fiora from the current shared Loading node Custom gradient: Linear 0deg, #EC379A at 0%, #F58FC5 at 100%, both 100% opacity. Preserve legacy beam.gradient for Custom and feed authored stops to border and inward light with unchanged movement/exposure.
checks: Focused palette/codec/handoff units; real native gradient parts and switch-back preservation; focused feature gate; local preview; publication comparison
risks: The current production deployment was built on the home Mac mini and its updated runtime source is absent here. Do not redeploy this older runtime over the current live Dots fix.
